stem.text: Which statement about progressive transverse and longitudinal waves is correct?

A.text: Particles in a transverse wave have fixed equilibrium positions but those in longitudinal waves do not.

B.text: Transverse waves can be polarised but longitudinal waves cannot.

C.text: Transverse waves transfer energy but longitudinal waves do not.

D.text: Two-source interference can be demonstrated with transverse waves but not with longitudinal waves.
